frame.x: horizontal, bracket length, +x outward (from the bolt end towards the clevis end)
frame.y: horizontal, parallel to the clevis pin axis
frame.z: vertical, normal to the mounting face z = 0, +z upward (away from the mounting face)
frame.origin: bottom corner of the allocated box

reference_point_meaning: pin centreline at the clevis midpoint (midplane between the two arms)

load_case_text.LC2_horizontal: 8,500 lbf horizontally outward (+x), normal to the pin axis
load_case_text.LC3_42deg: 9,500 lbf at 42 deg from vertical in the x-z plane (normal to the pin axis), tilted outward: F = 9500 (sin 42, 0, cos 42)
load_case_text.LC4_torsion: 5,000 lbf*in moment about the horizontal x axis through C (normal to the pin axis), applied as a zero-net-force couple

traction_transfer: equal-weight distributing coupling (RBE3 type) from C to all nodes of the two pin bores: f_i = F/N + omega x (x_i - xbar), J omega = M - (xbar - C) x F
supports: four rigid bolted interfaces: every node of a bolt boss on z = 0 and every node of a bolt bore inside the boss clamped (all three components)

element_classes.0: exterior (outside the envelope, pin bores, bolt holes, bolt clearance columns, clevis slot): modulus 0, not part of the structure
element_classes.2: protected solid (bolt bosses, lug eyes): density 1

material.E: normalized E0 = 1, Emin = 1e-9 for void designable elements; compliance in code units; physical compliance = 2 C_code / (E_phys h)

resultant_tolerance.rule: |sum F - F_target|_max <= rtol max(|F|, |M|/arm) and |sum M - M_target|_max <= rtol max(|M|, |F| arm)

source_note: parametric counterpart of a lifting (engine) bracket with four bolted interfaces and a two-arm clevis; dimensions chosen in this run, not taken from a third-party CAD file
